product.olivetti-m400-10.summary: The high-end 486SX M400 workstation with an i487SX option.
product.olivetti-m400-10.history: The September 1991 professional catalogue listed M400-10 (the high-end 486SX M400 workstation with an i487SX option).
product.olivetti-m400-10.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA296 / BA297 / BA309 / BA312 / BA313 · 82C452A · AT.
product.olivetti-m400-10.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash · 1.08 (BA901) / 2.08 (BA301).
product.olivetti-m400-10.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m400-10.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m400-10.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 25-1.
product.olivetti-m400-10.market: Olivetti, La gamma dei personal computer professionali, 3905621C-00, 9/91.
